participation.context: Named forty, refused the lease a place on the sheet, and shut the book.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Gave the doors as the cause, and would not price a beam.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Took forty, and would not average it with last Saturday.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Took it as the spring's best, and kept the boys off the sheet.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Took the same forty, and asked no second head for the dancing.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Took the coin, and would not wait on a beam.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Said forty back, left the chest uncounted, and kept Allen off the sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the sheet is the share, and the lease is a different paper

story.body: Heminges said the share and shut the book on it. You did not count the chest, and you did not reopen Monday.
